title: The Wheel of Time (TV series)
notes: "On May 23, 2025, Amazon Prime Video canceled the series after three seasons". Reviews describe it as departing from the books, so it is a separate continuity.

in_universe.label: Season 1
in_universe.note: "The first season is based on The Eye of the World (1990), with elements from The Great Hunt (1990) and The Dragon Reborn (1991)." No in-universe year given.

in_universe.label: Season 2
in_universe.note: "The second season is based on elements from both The Great Hunt and The Dragon Reborn."

in_universe.label: Season 3
in_universe.note: "The third season covers events from the fourth and fifth books, The Shadow Rising (1992) and The Fires of Heaven (1993)."

title: Winter Dragon
notes: A 22-minute pilot "based on the prologue to The Eye of the World" that aired once, to retain the adaptation rights; not canon.
